name: 温感变色由透明转粉润唇膏款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用开盖立管、立于旁的盖体与内部带细闪片的透明膏体同时交代器形与清水玻璃质感
一秒讲清本款主轴：同一唇形涂前近乎透明、涂后渐显清水粉，双栏同机位互证，两侧主张全部留占位
shots.textZone: 顶部两行标题位「{selling_point_1}」，右下一行小字说明位「{callout_1}」，两栏下方各一枚空白圆角标签位

shots.intent: 用低角微距证明膏体真正通透、内含细片悬浮均匀，回答透明质地疑虑
shots.textZone: 顶部标题带「{selling_point_2}」，其下一行短说明位「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 把上唇后的水玻璃光泽与膏体抹开的通透色带并置，一秒传达舒适润泽的核心利益，主张文字留占位
shots.textZone: 顶部标题位「{selling_point_3}」，其下一行短说明位「{callout_3}」

shots.intent: 把变色写成可 read 的三级渐进梯度，用同机位三格与圆形节点箭头位说明层次，格间主张一律留空
shots.textZone: 顶部两行标题位「{selling_point_4}」，格间两枚空白圆形节点位，右下一行小字说明位「{callout_4}」

shots.intent: 用三张编号流程卡讲清上手方式，把取料、等待显色与补涂拆成可代入的动作顺序
shots.textZone: 顶部标题带「{selling_point_5}」，三卡各一枚空白圆形编号位与其下一条短句位「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」

shots.intent: 把产品放进真实日常台面与随身袋，让人群代入通勤补妆场景
shots.textZone: 顶部标题位「{selling_point_3}」与其下一行短说明位「{callout_5}」

shots.intent: 收口交代到手内容物与器形组件，全部凭证与参数位留成空白框由买家自行填入

style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and inset wear crops, clear-water pink #F7DDE3 for the colour-change and step layouts, glassy pale aqua-white #E7F2F3 for macro and vanity scenes; the dewy rose #E5A6B4 is only ever a hairline rule, node circle or label pill outline, never a lip hue, because every tint value is carried by the accent placeholder
style.direction: clear watery-pink glass-finish lip tint commerce
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight hairline rules, blank rounded label pills and small circular step nodes outlined in dewy rose #E5A6B4, no filled illustrations and no tick or cross graphics
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key neutral studio light, front-left softbox key with a fill card, skimming sweep across the transparent bullet so its glass depth reads, butterfly light on skin crops, soft contact shadows only, controlled clean speculars on glass-like surfaces
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clear watery-pink lip tint visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless pure white #FFFFFF, clear-water pink #F7DDE3, glassy pale aqua-white #E7F2F3 and one dewy rose accent #E5A6B4, with every lip tint hue carried by one accent placeholder; bright even high-key neutral studio lighting with a front-left softbox key and fill card, skimming sweep across the transparent bullet, butterfly light on skin crops, soft contact shadows and controlled clean speculars; modern geometric sans-serif typography only; thin single-weight hairline rules, blank rounded label pills and small circular step nodes; stable straight-on to slight 3/4 product anchor angle with the bullet always reading glass-clear; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no fixed lip tint hue across the set
no warm cream, taupe or ash-brown surfaces anywhere in the set
style.presentationRules: one open square-column tube anchor reused at stable scale with the bullet always reading glass-clear, every lip crop taken from the nose down so no identity shows, and every lip tint hue carried by the accent placeholder instead of a fixed shade
style.surfaceSystem: seamless white sweep plus clear-water pink matte boards #F7DDE3 and one polished pale glass counter #E7F2F3, no horizon line and no warm beige tabletop
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif only: one oversized headline, one thin sub-line and short step labels, all in-image copy supplied at generation time as placeholders
